bio:
Greg is a dedicated real estate professional who prides himself on building genuine relationships and delivering a high level of service throughout every stage of the property journey. With a strong work ethic and a genuine passion for real estate, Greg understands that buying or selling a home is one of the biggest decisions his clients will make and believes it deserves honest advice, clear communication and unwavering commitment.


Originally from South Africa, Greg moved to Sydney with his family at the age of four and has spent most of his life in the Eastern Suburbs. His appreciation for the area's lifestyle, community and diverse range of homes, combined with his enthusiasm for property, allows him to connect with clients on a personal level while providing valuable local insight.


As part of the JT Allen Real Estate team, Greg approaches every opportunity with professionalism, energy and a commitment to achieving the best possible outcome. Whether assisting buyers in finding the right home or guiding vendors through the sales process, his focus is on building trust, creating lasting relationships and delivering an experience that clients can genuinely enjoy.
name: Greg Diamond

bio:
Ryan is a highly accomplished real estate professional recognised as a leading sales agent. With over $300,000,000 in property sales and more than 80 homes successfully sold, Ryan has built a reputation for delivering exceptional results across Dover Heights, North Bondi, and Rose Bay.

Known for a strategic approach and unparalleled local market knowledge, Ryan combines tailored marketing campaigns with expert negotiation skills to achieve outstanding outcomes for clients. Whether working with buyers or sellers, Ryan is committed to creating seamless, rewarding experiences, ensuring every detail is handled with professionalism and care.

Clients consistently praise Ryan for his transparency, dedication, and ability to navigate the unique challenges of the real estate market. From start to finish, Ryan provides guidance and expertise that instills confidence and delivers results.

Available 7 Days a week
name: Ryan Rubinstein

bio:
Starting as a trainee in her family’s real estate business at just 15, Nicole has been a property manager for over 30 years. Eastern Suburbs real estate has become her speciality, profession and passion. 

Her role is normally one of client liaison, giving both landlords and tenants 5-star service and redefining their Real Estate Agent experience. With background studies in finance, business and valuation at UTS and a lifetime of dedicated property management experience, she excels and focuses on relationship building and values the strong rewards and trusting bonds formed with her clients. 

“I love working with the dedicated and fun team at JT Allen and feel that clients are in the best possible hands with this hard-working, high energy ambitious team.” - Nicole
name: Nicole Sirtes

bio:
With over 15 years of experience in the property management industry, Zac Morgan is a trusted leader known for his strategic insight, operational precision, and unwavering commitment to excellence. As Head of Property Management at JT Allen Real Estate, Zac leads a high-performing team that sets the benchmark for service and professionalism in Sydney’s competitive real estate landscape.

Zac’s career has been defined by his ability to anticipate challenges, streamline processes, and deliver tailored solutions that protect assets and foster long-term relationships. His deep understanding of tenancy legislation, conflict resolution, and NCAT proceedings ensures that both landlords and tenants receive expert guidance and support at every stage.

Having overseen the leasing and management of some of Australia’s most prestigious luxury properties, Zac brings a nuanced understanding of the easter suburbs and inner Sydney market and a refined approach to high-value asset management. His expertise extends to:

NCAT case preparation, advisory, and representation

Conflict resolution and stakeholder management

Tenancy legislation and compliance

Landlord insurance claims and risk mitigation

Strategic leasing campaigns and market positioning

Zac is passionate about elevating industry standards and empowering his team to lead with knowledge, integrity, and a customer-first mindset. For Zac, exceptional property management is not just about maintaining properties; it’s about building trust, delivering value, and creating seamless experiences for all parties involved.
name: Zac Morgan

bio:
Fiona brings a creative background in marketing, PR, events, and advertising, along with valuable experience in the real estate industry. She loves being part of a fast-paced environment where every day is different.

Having called the eastern suburbs home for more than 20 years, Fiona has a genuine love for the area and a strong understanding of the local community. She takes pride in building great relationships and is dedicated to making the buying and selling process as smooth and positive as possible for every client.
name: Fiona Scotts

bio:
With over 24 years of experience in the real estate industry, Dalia Raymundo brings extensive expertise in property management, business development and client relations. Having successfully owned and operated her own boutique real estate agency for 16 years, she understands the value of building long-term relationships founded on trust, integrity and exceptional service.



Holding a Bachelor of Laws, Dalia combines strong industry knowledge with a strategic, solutions-focused approach. She is passionate about helping property owners maximise the performance of their investments through honest advice, clear communication, and personalised service.



As Business Development Manager at JT Allen Real Estate, Dalia is committed and dedicated to building lasting relationships and delivering a seamless experience for every client. Her commitment to professionalism, integrity and outstanding service gives property owners confidence that their investment is in experienced and capable hands.
name: Dalia Raymundo

bio:
Born and raised in Bondi, Teo brings an authentic understanding of the Eastern Suburbs lifestyle and property market. Having grown up at the beach and immersed in the local community, he offers genuine insight into what makes the Eastern Suburbs such a highly sought-after place to live.

Teo is known for his clear and detailed communication, his ability to build strong relationships with both buyers and sellers, and his focus on simplifying the sales process. Backed by the JT Allen team, he is committed to delivering a professional, transparent and high-quality experience at every stage of a property transaction. He approaches real estate with energy, discipline and a strong work ethic, driven by a desire to elevate the reputation of the industry through honesty, commitment and consistent results for his vendors.
name: Teo Wilson

bio:
We’re excited to welcome Luis to our property management team, a dedicated professional who brings both strength and heart to everything he does.

Luis is based in Potts Point and brings a strong service mindset shaped by a decade as a personal trainer. Known for his transparency, reliability, and follow-through, he approaches every engagement with honesty and integrity, setting clear expectations and delivering on commitments. His background combines client-centric communication, disciplined execution, and a focus on measurable outcomes—skills he now channels into driving results for our clients and team.



He is excited to begin this new chapter and is committed to providing first-class service while building trusted relationships with our clients.
name: Luis Newman

bio:
Elle is a dedicated property management professional who brings a strong background in residential property management and leasing, along with a genuine passion for delivering exceptional client service.

Known for her approachable nature, attention to detail and proactive communication, Elle works closely with landlords and tenants to ensure every aspect of the management process is handled with care and professionalism. She understands that every property and client is unique, taking the time to provide tailored advice and practical solutions that help achieve the best possible outcomes.

Relocating to Sydney from Queensland, Elle is excited to combine her industry experience with a fresh perspective and a commitment to building lasting relationships based on trust, transparency and reliability. Her organised approach and client-first mindset make her a valued adviser for property owners seeking confidence and peace of mind in the management of their investment.
name: Elle Norris

bio:
Elena Sladkova is a dedicated Property Manager with a background in psychology and hands-on experience in both residential property and building management. Holding a Bachelor of Psychology, she brings strong interpersonal skills, a calm approach to problem-solving, and a deep understanding of client needs.



Fluent in English and Russian, Elena works confidently across Sydney’s diverse market, offering landlords and tenants a service that is responsive, organised, and grounded in professionalism. Her attention to detail, clear communication, and proactive management style ensure every property is cared for to the highest standard.
name: Elena Sladkova
